text:
Keisha N.: UmbraTech sent an RFI asking for a compact capability matrix + POC quote. Key asks: HSM (BYOK), VPC peering, EU-only residency, and a one-page security summary. RFI uploaded: s3://redwood-sales/umbra/rfi/umbra-rfi-2026.pdf

Marco Alvarez: Suggest 3-day POC: day 0 prep + identity mapping, day 1 ingest & embeddings checks, day 2 perf/scale + handoff. Include replay script and minimal prompt set.

Priya Gopal: For pricing propose $3k platform credits + up to $1k infra stipend for on-prem kit. If Umbra converts to Dedicated within 45 days, offer 25% credit on month 1. Finance to confirm.

Keisha N.: They provided expected load: ~60 concurrent sessions peak, ~4k embeddings/day, EU-only storage requirement. They specifically asked about key export from HSM.

Priya Gopal: Security answer: we support BYOK into customer-managed HSMs (PKCS#11/CloudHSM). We do NOT permit export of private key material from customer HSMs. Hosted customers can request dedicated encryption controls under enterprise contract.

Marco Alvarez: Matrix columns: Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes. Rows: tenant isolation, per-tenant KMS, HSM import, VPC peering, regional residency, audit logs, SLA. I'll mark Dedicated SLO as 99.9% (model-dependent) and note autoscale.

LegalBot: NDA + DPA required before ingestion. Recommend scoped SOW that limits retention to 30 days for POC and specifies deletion verification steps. Pen-test requests need 10 business days notice and a scoped plan.

InfraBot: Tentative POC kickoff: 2026-08-18 09:00 BST. Invite sent to umbra-poc@umbratech.com.

Keisha N.: I'll assemble deliverables: capability_matrix_umbra_v1.xlsx, rfi_answers_umbra_v1.md, poc_quote_umbra_v1.pdf and upload to s3://redwood-sales/umbra/deliverables/. Aim to return RFI today.

Priya Gopal: Small note for answers: call out per-tenant key rotation, audit trails, and that FedRAMP is roadmap; offer SOC2 + isolated Dedicated tenancy as compensating controls.

Marco Alvarez: Added eval curl snippet for embeddings and a tiny harness. Example:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":["doc a","doc b"]}'

Keisha N.: Thanks all. If no blockers from finance/legal I'll send the package this afternoon. :thumbsup:
